lifecycles._note: Firewall lifecycle — anchored by listfirewalls GET (light-runnable, 200 confirmed live 2026-06-20 and 2026-06-29). A firewall is auto-created implicitly when a VPC carrier resource (IGW/Direct Connect/LB) is created with firewall_enabled:true — there is NO POST /v1/firewalls standalone endpoint. The listfirewalls step anchors the lifecycle as light-runnable (returns 200 with empty list when no firewalls exist). The 4 write ops and 3 id-bound GETs (showfirewall, listfirewallrules?firewall_id=, showfirewallrule) all require a real firewall_id which only exists after a VPC+IGW create (needs-heavy). Write steps remain optional probes using {unique} as a fake id (expected ResourceNotFound 404 — api returns JSON error, not portal HTML, confirming backend routing is correct). listfirewallrules GET requires firewall_id query param (REQUIRED per api_docs) — not coverable read-only without a real id. Bodies from api_docs.json: createfirewallrule wraps the rule in {firewall_id, firewall_rule:{...}}; setfirewall takes {flavor_name, loggable}; setfirewallrule takes a bare rule body. Promote write ops to a real create->delete chain once a firewall-bearing IGW is wired in as a prerequisite (see networking__firewall.yaml carrier-capture).
